visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise overlays (opacity-5) on the main background to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.accents: Use 1px glowing borders (blue/cyan) on active elements.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use 'Lucide-React' icons. Thin strokes (1.5px). Text-zinc-400 default, text-blue-400 active.

login_bg.usage: Full screen background for login page with overlay

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SET UP THE THEME: Ensure 'dark' class is applied to the html/body by default. Use the color palette defined above in tailwind.config.js.
2. TYPOGRAPHY: Import 'Outfit' and 'Inter' from Google Fonts. Apply 'Inter' to body and 'Outfit' to all headings.
3. LAYOUT: Create a Sidebar Layout. Sidebar (w-64) fixed on left, Header fixed top, Main Content scrollable area.
4. DATA GRID: Use AG Grid or TanStack Table for the hospital list, but style it heavily. Remove default borders, use zeal-zinc-800 for row dividers, hover:bg-zinc-800/50 for rows.
5. CARDS: Implement the 'Hospital Card' with the glassmorphism effect. Include 'Email', 'Phone', 'Location' icons.
6. MAP: If a map library is too complex, create a stylized CSS-only map visualization or use the region images as a 'visual selector' grid.
7. ANIMATIONS: Add 'Framer Motion' for page transitions and list entry animations. Stagger children for the hospital list.
8. AUTH: The login page must be impressive. Use the 'login_bg' image with a heavy dark overlay (bg-black/80) so text is readable. Center the login form or split 50/50.
9. REGION FILTER: Use a horizontal scrollable strip of buttons or a grid of small cards with the city images for selecting regions (Riyadh, Dammam, Dubai, etc.).
10. TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters).
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
